# E15 build plan

Planning artifact for senior review, not implementation greenlight. The design is frozen. The only cold review is `docs/tdd/reviews/E15.astra-r1.md:1`, verdict CHANGES REQUESTED, with 23 open findings and no answer file. `docs/requests/E15.md` does not exist. Nothing in this plan silently approves its section 14 proposals.

## Build order and connections

1. T1 provides pure domain rules, canonical application ports and conditional configuration. It settles provider signatures before consumers compile.
2. T2 consumes T1 and builds the single SQLite repository, additive migration, authorized queries, rules adapter and RecordsView. It never implements another epic's data source.
3. T3 consumes T1/T2 and first delivers E15-core, then commands, producer attachment, reconciliation, API and HTTP acceptance. Core has only E01/E02/E23 hard dependencies. E04, E11 and E22 bind later, per `docs/SYSTEM.md:2342`. One task owns each application source file throughout both stages.
4. T4 starts after T1 against approved generated contracts and E03's shell, in parallel with T2/T3. Its real Playwright hand-in waits for T3. This is an acceptance dependency, not a reason to serialize component work.

Task ownership is exact in tasks.json. Domain/application protocols are T1; SQL/read/config adapters are T2; mutation orchestration and all HTTP acceptance are T3; feature UI is T4. New test subdirectories are allocated beneath the existing ownership grant `hub/tests/episodes/**` (`docs/tdd/E15.md:957`). No task owns shared registration, contracts, shell, provider code, engine code or eval files. T2 owns builders.py; tests elsewhere consume it without editing it. No task changes the frozen design.

At inspection there is no hub/, ui/ or eval/ implementation. contracts/ and config/ contain only pharmacy artifacts. Ownership was checked against every available docs/build/*/tasks.json and section 13 of every available epic design. The final audit included E02, E03, E05, E10, E12, E20, E21, E24, E28 and E32. Planners are adding files concurrently, so coders recheck before edits. E09 and E16 provider designs/request files are absent; imported-diagnosis and ground-review acceptance cannot be specified from a guessed port. E01's generated contracts, kernel.testing, composition root and standalone uv project are prerequisites, not work to recreate. Unit work uses documented kernel fakes; production and acceptance never substitute fakes inside the hub (`docs/SYSTEM.md:2388`). Missing shared declarations block only dependent work.

Additional concrete corrections: SYSTEM 4.2's `episodes_followup` replaces section 5.1's `episodes_task`; its other prefixed tables remain. Section 5.1 task triggers must permit revision-checked owner/deadline changes while open with matching events. SYSTEM 5.10.1 owns correction retries, leases and generations; episodes_effect is the immutable input/reference and protective reconciliation record, not a second worker queue. SYSTEM 5.11 replaces the literal two-release cache limit and registers every operational ceiling. E01 publishes AnswerAccepted once; E15 never republishes it. E12's current dependency is EpisodeFacts (`docs/tdd/E12.md:134`), not an invented broad tool reader. Part A Q1/Q7/Q18 supersede signature-only activation rejection; source/purpose/applicability checks remain mandatory.

T0 uses laptop hub and signed-in browser with manual input, model/devices/link absent. T1/T2 add authorized browsers and enrolled tablets with memory-only clinical views. T3 adds devices, T4 habitat feeds and T5 read-only integration, none an E15 dependency. T6 keeps each episode authoritative at its home hub; remote findings are new records, divergent versions retained for an authorized human. T7 carries only approved snapshot advice and authenticated replies, never remote episode commands or live-chart subscriptions. These are DEPLOYMENT sections 3 to 5, not new E15 transport mechanisms.

## Test ownership and end-to-end evidence

All tests carry `traces` R/V/D/invariant markers as in `docs/tdd/E15.md:881`. T1 owns unit/property evidence for T-E15-001/004/005/006/008/012/013/019/020/023/042/043/048 and pure visibility/time/onset rules. T2 owns contract/storage evidence for T-E15-009/010/014/016/018/019/020/021/025/026/027/028/030/032/033/034/035/038/041/042/044/045/046/047. T3 owns HTTP/integration counterparts T-E15-001 through 037 and 041 through 048. T4 owns T-E15-038/039/040 and visual/privacy counterparts. Overlapping test IDs mean distinct owned evidence layers, never two editors on one file. These ranges cover all 48 design tests; changed expectations are in the deviations, not removed tests.

Every row below is mandatory real-stack evidence. T3 drives the normal composition root's HTTP API with real SQLite in a temporary directory, no hub mocks. T4 drives Playwright against that hub. Fixtures come through E21's frozen explicit demo profile or documented production adapters; SQL insertion is not a scenario. Unit fakes prove only unit behavior. Missing counterpart/provider means blocked, not pass or skip.

| End-to-end path | What it proves | Owner and trace |
|---|---|---|
| Create, answer all pinned red flags with model stopped | Draft exits only on accepted answers, no invented absence; actual red flags precede model work. | T3/T4; R18/R28, D05, T023/035 |
| Severe breathing with normal SpO2; repeat of concerning first measurement | Normal repeat never closes symptoms or delays indicated urgent response. Urgency disposition remains separate. | T3; V02/V03, T006/007/022 |
| Acknowledge, review two assessments, follow-up, resolve/reopen | Attributed seen/review/resolution differ; uncovered/stale work stays; remaining rhythm task has owner, overdue is visible. Model/devices/link absent. | T3/T4; V04, R18/R28, T002/003/018/036/037 |
| Failed then accepted attempt, ECG unavailable | Failure reason/history retained, no failed value; pulse is not ECG, honest gap and supported next step remain. | T3/T4; V18/V28, D08/D12, T021/022 |
| Declined sensitive answer and cross-person request | Declined is retained, never negative; grants apply to raw/derived objects and counts, refs, errors and events. Forged tool scope is rejected server-side through E12/E13. | T3/T4; V12/V25/V26, T014/030/045 |
| Lost response, concurrent retry and restart | Exactly one command after weeks, changed-target conflict; kill after accepted commit before UI update, then cursor recovery finds retained record. | T3/T4; V16/V35, R25, T025/026/027/028 |
| Correction while actual inference is in flight | E13's documented external stub/hold keeps inference open; correction invalidates its snapshot, result stale and unusable, protective work survives E13 failure. Repeat for no-assessment resolution, onset, report findings and both resolve/correct interleavings. | T3; V30, R06, T015/016/017/044 |
| Import clinician diagnosis | E09 confirmed source, imported author and reviewer stay attributed; no model-confirmed claim. Mere review creation is insufficient. | T3/T4; V38 |
| SIM urgent case alongside LIVE and REPLAY | Complete identity partition; foreign association refused while valid capture survives; no real external message. | T3/T4; V40, T032 |
| Concern/update day without daily check | Real E22 accepts concern/answer/help completion once, no value/outcome dependence, no REPLAY contribution. | T3; V43/R33, T029 |
| Demo acts 4/5 and delayed ground | Local review leaves unresolved rhythm; approved handoff stays queued with next contact and consented snapshot; no episode/plan transition waits and no E15 GroundLink read. Provider clauses of D13/D40/D43 remain required. | T3/T4; D13/D40/D43, R48, T031/037 |
| Keyboard, origin, failures and clinical screens | No participation/celebration element across concern/measurement/assessment/shared care; unknown, stale, acting and overdue readable without color. | T4; D14/V36/V43, T038/039/040 |
| Configuration, failed dependencies and privacy loss | Real loader edit changes non-safety text/new task policy; existing pins stay; invalid document rejected; no E13 means explicit unavailable components; stream loss/expiry/lock/revocation clears or refreshes authorized memory. | T3/T4; R02/R43, T014/030/036/038/041/042 |

T3 additionally injects each AGENTS 6 failure at acceptance boundaries: crash, retry, forward/backward clock and mission boundary, disk full, missing/corrupt config, partial/implausible/conflicting input, two clients, long link backlog, incapacitated patient, absent officers and cross-crew privacy. Unrelated device/model processing remains provider-owned. Dissimilar backups are SQL safeguards with domain bypass, independent E11 urgency and immediate local correction protection with E13 removed. Storage/IO/integrity faults roll back acceptance; only typed evaluator computation failures preserve capture with durable pending recovery.

Task gates in tasks.json are exact future commands selected from SYSTEM 6, E01 section 15 and charter 8. They are not executable today because their projects/tools/providers are absent. C8 must extend the shared inventory before safety/mutations/trace can count E15. The shared coverage gate must require branch-only coverage of at least 95 percent independently for each executable module in episodes/domain and episodes/application, using the branch JSON inventory and rejecting omitted/unmeasured modules. Modules with no branches use line coverage and cannot dilute another module. Safety decisions require full true/false condition evidence and complexity at most 15 per function. Mutation scope is state_machine.py, derivation.py, resolution.py, followup.py and visibility.py (E15 section 12); every non-equivalent critical mutant must be killed, with independently reviewed equivalence evidence. An E01-only gate or aggregate pytest-cov percentage is insufficient. C8 must configure these semantics in E01-owned hub/pyproject.toml and the shared checker before hand-in. Full hand-in also requires CI and independent review. No implementation test was run for this planning task.
